SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(fare), 1) AS avg_fare
FROM trips
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city ASC;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(fare), 1) AS avg_fare
FROM rides
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city ASC;

SELECT
    driver,
    ROUND(SUM(distance_km), 1) AS total_km
FROM trips
GROUP BY driver
ORDER BY total_km DESC;

SELECT
    driver,
    ROUND(SUM(distance_km), 1) AS total_km
FROM rides
GROUP BY driver
ORDER BY total_km DESC;

SELECT
    service,
    env,
    COUNT(*) AS deploy_count
FROM deploys
GROUP BY service, env
ORDER BY service ASC, env ASC;

SELECT
    service,
    COUNT(*) AS failed_count
FROM deploys
WHERE status = 'failed'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY service ASC;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(fare), 1) AS avg_fare
FROM rides
WHERE distance_km > 10
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city ASC;

SELECT
    team,
    COUNT(*) AS closed_p1
FROM tickets
WHERE priority = 'P1'
  AND status = 'closed'
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY team ASC;

SELECT
    service,
    ROUND(AVG(duration_seconds), 1) AS avg_seconds
FROM deploys
WHERE env = 'prod'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC;

SELECT
    service,
    ROUND(AVG(deploys), 1) AS avg_seconds
FROM deploys
WHERE env = 'prod'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC;

SELECT
    service,
    ROUND(AVG(VALUES), 1) AS avg_seconds
FROM deploys
WHERE env = 'prod'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC;

SELECT
    service,
    ROUND(AVG('VALUES'), 1) AS avg_seconds
FROM deploys
WHERE env = 'prod'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC;

SELECT
    priority,
    MAX(close_hours) AS longest_hours
FROM tickets
WHERE status = 'closed'
GROUP BY priority
ORDER BY
    CASE priority
        WHEN 'P1' THEN 1
        WHEN 'P2' THEN 2
        WHEN 'P3' THEN 3
        WHEN 'P4' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;

SELECT
    priority,
    MAX(hours_to_close) AS longest_hours
FROM tickets
WHERE status = 'closed'
GROUP BY priority
ORDER BY
    CASE priority
        WHEN 'P1' THEN 1
        WHEN 'P2' THEN 2
        WHEN 'P3' THEN 3
        WHEN 'P4' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;

SELECT
    env,
    COUNT(*) AS success_count
FROM deploys
WHERE status = 'success'
  AND service <> 'auth'
GROUP BY env
ORDER BY env ASC;

SELECT
    service,
    COUNT(*) AS deploy_count
FROM deploys
GROUP BY service
HAVING COUNT(*) > 6
ORDER BY service ASC;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(fare), 1) AS avg_fare
FROM rides
GROUP BY city
HAVING AVG(fare) > 200
ORDER BY avg_fare DESC;

SELECT
    team,
    SUM(close_hours) AS total_hours
FROM tickets
GROUP BY team
HAVING SUM(close_hours) > 300
ORDER BY team ASC;

SELECT
    team,
    SUM(hours_to_close) AS total_hours
FROM tickets
GROUP BY team
HAVING SUM(close_hours) > 300
ORDER BY team ASC;

SELECT
    team,
    SUM(hours_to_close) AS total_hours
FROM tickets
GROUP BY team
HAVING SUM(close_hours) > 300
ORDER BY team ASC;

SELECT
    team,
    SUM(hours_to_close) AS total_hours
FROM tickets
GROUP BY team
HAVING SUM(hours_to_close) > 300
ORDER BY team ASC;

SELECT
    driver,
    COUNT(*) AS ride_count
FROM rides
GROUP BY driver
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7
ORDER BY ride_count DESC;

SELECT
    service,
    MIN(duration_seconds) AS fastest_seconds
FROM deploys
GROUP BY service
HAVING MIN(duration_seconds) >= 60
ORDER BY service ASC;

SELECT
    service,
    MIN(duration_sec) AS fastest_seconds
FROM deploys
GROUP BY service
HAVING MIN(duration_seconds) >= 60
ORDER BY service ASC;

SELECT
    service,
    MIN(duration_sec) AS fastest_seconds
FROM deploys
GROUP BY service
HAVING MIN(duration_seconds) >= 60
ORDER BY service ASC;

SELECT
    service,
    MIN(duration_sec) AS fastest_seconds
FROM deploys
GROUP BY service
HAVING MIN(duration_sec) >= 60
ORDER BY service ASC;

SELECT
    priority,
    ROUND(AVG(close_hours), 1) AS avg_hours
FROM tickets
GROUP BY priority
HAVING AVG(close_hours) < 45
ORDER BY
    CASE priority
        WHEN 'P1' THEN 1
        WHEN 'P2' THEN 2
        WHEN 'P3' THEN 3
        WHEN 'P4' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;

SELECT
    priority,
    ROUND(AVG(hours_to_close), 1) AS avg_hours
FROM tickets
GROUP BY priority
HAVING AVG(hours_to_close) < 45
ORDER BY
    CASE priority
        WHEN 'P1' THEN 1
        WHEN 'P2' THEN 2
        WHEN 'P3' THEN 3
        WHEN 'P4' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(SUM(distance_km), 1) AS total_km
FROM rides
GROUP BY city
HAVING SUM(distance_km) > 100
ORDER BY total_km DESC;
